items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: My brother got in this business with Joe Sycaluca about 30 years ago, and about 22 years ago, I come with him here. After Joe died, I come in this business with him.

ctx.x: How'd you happen to get in this business?
My brother got in this business with Joe Sycaluca about 30 years ago, and about 22 years ago, I come with him here. After Joe died, I come in this business with him.
That's in Sydney? Sydney, yeah. Well, your family's been on Decatur Street a long time, huh?
